title: LRU Cache
description: Design a fixed-capacity cache with O(1) get and put that evicts the least recently used key when capacity is exceeded.

reference.use_case: Keeping a bounded in-memory cache of recently used items and evicting the item unused for the longest when space runs out.
system_examples: Memcached — evicts least recently used items within each slab class
Redis — allkeys-lru / volatile-lru eviction policies (an approximated LRU using sampling)
Operating-system page caches — LRU-like replacement such as Linux's active/inactive page lists
reference.explanation: A hash map gives O(1) lookup and a doubly linked list gives O(1) move-to-front and tail eviction, so both operations are O(1). Production systems often approximate it (Redis sampling, CLOCK in kernels) to save memory and contention, but this is the reference design.
